geometryBlock: Photorealistic product photograph of the EXACT ring shown in the reference image (use it for the ring's shape, facets and cuts{METAL_NOTE}), remade in real solid {METAL_DESC}. It is one closed, continuous wedding band — never a cropped slab, open ring or C-shape. SHAPE: the outer surface is NOT a smooth round band. It is made of FLAT FACETS: about eight wide, flat rectangular panels going around the ring, like a polygon, each panel finished in a fine frosted sandblasted matte texture (even and granular, not brushed lines, not hammered). Where two flat panels meet, a broad POLISHED transverse cut runs straight across the full width of the band, from edge to edge: some joints are ONE wide, smooth, scooped channel (a glossy concave cove about a quarter of a panel wide); other joints are a small polished STAIRCASE of two bars side by side, one flat and one rounded. These polished cuts are broad, mirror-bright and sculptural, NOT thin engraved lines, NOT ribs, NOT reeding, NOT stripes. EDGES: along both edges of the band the facets step down to a narrow polished rail. INTERIOR: smooth polished comfort fit, no text. The whole ring is ONE metal colour. Clean new metal: no rust, no tarnish, no spots, no dust. NO text, letters, numbers, karat stamps or hallmarks anywhere. No stones, no pave, no milgrain beads, no leaves, no diagonal cuts. NO GLOVES.
lightingBlock: LIGHTING: a real home studio, not a CGI render. One large window is the only light source; soft directional daylight with a genuine soft-edged shadow. The gold looks like real metal photographed in daylight. No seamless backdrop, no gradient sweep, no glitter, no lens flare, no sparkle overlays.

scenes.job: Win the search grid at 170 px: a complete ring, flat facets and polished cuts legible.
scenes.composition: Like the reference photo: the ring stands on its edge, tilted and seen at three-quarters from slightly above, close up, so two or three flat frosted facets and the polished transverse cuts between them fill most of the frame, with the open center and the polished inner wall visible on one side. It rests on a dark charcoal-grey suede surface with a soft, even nap, the background falling off into the same dark grey.

scenes.job: Trust: a real hand, real skin, the ring encircling exactly one finger.
scenes.composition: Worn on the ring finger of a relaxed adult hand resting on a light linen cloth; the band fully encircles exactly ONE finger and every other finger is bare. Natural, unretouched skin with real texture, short clean unpolished nails. The polished cuts and rails catch the window light against the matte facets.

scenes.job: Show the one thing that makes this ring: broad polished cuts between flat sandblasted facets.
scenes.composition: The ring LIES FLAT on its side like a coin, its opening facing the ceiling, on a dark charcoal-grey suede surface with a soft, even nap. The camera is very close and low, only a few centimetres from the near side of the band, so the outer face fills most of the frame from left edge to right edge: one polished transverse cut in razor-sharp focus in the middle, a flat frosted facet on each side of it, and the stepped polished rails visible along the top and bottom edges of the band. The far side of the closed ring falls softly out of focus. This is NOT a standing ring and NOT a full view of the ring: it is a detail study of the outer surface.

scenes.job: Answer 'which width?': the same design in narrow, medium and wide.
scenes.composition: THREE rings of this exact design lying side by side on a dark charcoal-grey suede surface with a soft, even nap, left to right: a narrow 3 mm band, a medium 5 mm band, a wide 8 mm band. Same metal, same flat frosted facets, same polished transverse cuts and stepped rails, scaled to each width. All three are closed complete rings. Top-down three-quarter angle, even daylight.

scenes.job: Answer 'how does it sit?': show the stepped edge profile, not just the face.
scenes.composition: The ring lies FLAT like a coin, its opening facing the ceiling, on a low block wrapped in dark charcoal-grey suede, photographed from a low angle close to the surface so the outline reads as a POLYGON of flat facets and the side wall reads as a STEP down to the narrow polished rail. Soft window light from one side.

scenes.job: Everyday wear: the ring in a natural moment.
scenes.composition: A hand wearing the ring wraps around a plain matte ceramic coffee cup on a wooden table in morning window light; the band encircles exactly one finger and every other finger is bare. Natural skin, candid, no manicure, no bouquet, no petals.

scenes.job: State the facts exactly: karats, widths, sizes, finish.

geometryBlockV1_superseded: Photorealistic photograph of the EXACT ring design shown in the reference image, remade in real solid {METAL_DESC}. It is a closed, continuous 360-degree wedding band — never a cropped slab, straight segment, open ring or C-shape. PROFILE: a FLAT-topped raised center band with straight side walls; on each side the band steps DOWN to a narrow, lower, mirror-polished rail that runs around both edges, so the cross-section is stepped, not domed. CENTER FINISH: a fine frosted SANDBLASTED matte texture — even, granular and non-reflective; not brushed lines, not hammered, not glossy. GROOVES: at regular intervals around the ring, PAIRS of narrow polished grooves are cut straight ACROSS the width of the center band, perpendicular to the ring's circumference. Each pair is two parallel rounded channels side by side, mirror-polished inside, and the pairs divide the frosted center into equal rectangular sections (roughly six to eight pairs around the whole ring, evenly spaced). The grooves are recessed channels cut into the metal, never raised bars and never holes through the band; each one runs from rail to rail and stops at the step. INTERIOR: smooth mirror-polished comfort fit, no text. Clean new metal: no tarnish, no dark spots, no green or brass tone, no dust. NO GLOVES anywhere in the image. NO text, letters, numbers, karat stamps or hallmarks anywhere on the ring, inside or outside. No stones, no pave, no sparkle set into the ring. Do NOT add: gemstones, diamonds, crystals, milgrain beads, hammering, rope, leaves, diagonal cuts, a continuous groove running around the ring, engraving on the outside, or any second pattern.
